title: Drug Screening of Flavonoids as Potential VEGF Inhibitors Through Computational Docking and Cell Models.
authors: Lin, Shengying; Tang, Roy Wai-Lun; Ye, Yutong; Xia, Chenxi; Wu, Jiahui; Duan, Ran; Leung, Ka-Wing; Dong, Tina Ting-Xia; Tsim, Karl Wah-Keung
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算对接和细胞模型筛选黄酮类VEGF抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), also known as VEGF-A, has been linked to various diseases, such as wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD) and cancer. Even though there are VEGF inhibitors that are currently commercially available in clinical applications, severe adverse effects have been associated with these treatments. There is still a need to develop novel VEGF-based therapeutics against these VEGF-related diseases. Here, we established a series of VEGF-based computational docking analyses and cell models, such as a wound healing assay in HaCaT cells and an evaluation of NF-kappaB performance in macrophages, to screen a large library of flavonoid-type phytochemicals. Three flavonoids, namely, farrerol, ononin and (-)-epicatechin, were shown to express binding affinities to VEGF protein and inhibit VEGF-mediated biological activities. The investigation evidently suggested that the three flavonoids above could be considered potential anti-VEGF agents for the following drug development against VEGF-mediated diseases.
abstract_zh: 血管内皮生长因子（VEGF），也称为VEGF-A，与多种疾病相关，如湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性（wAMD）和癌症。尽管目前临床上已有市售的VEGF抑制剂，但这些治疗伴随有严重的不良反应。因此，仍需开发基于VEGF的新型疗法以应对这些VEGF相关疾病。在此，我们建立了一系列基于VEGF的计算对接分析和细胞模型，如HaCaT细胞中的伤口愈合实验及巨噬细胞中NF-kappaB活性的评估，以筛选大量类黄酮植物化学物质。三种黄酮类化合物，即法罗尔（farrerol）、奥诺宁（ononin）和（-）-表儿茶素（(-)-epicatechin），被证明对VEGF蛋白具有结合亲和力，并能抑制VEGF介导的生物学活性。研究明确表明，上述三种黄酮类化合物可被视为潜在的抗VEGF药物，用于后续针对VEGF介导疾病的药物开发。
